nativeAccountingGap.scope: Bounded native API accounting during the labelled chase/shadow/reflection warmup; not isolated GPU execution timing.
interpretation: Large elapsed gaps after returned useProgram calls are outside the wrapped API accounting; the trace does not identify their CPU/driver/GPU ownership.

The stage label changes before the first pit-service fence; production order confirms that this fence also covers the preceding whole chase submission. Its pending time cannot be attributed solely to pit-service work.
The sum uses the first and last observed activity samples within the stage, not an exact CPU profile of the entire stage.

limitations: Native CPU call time may include queued earlier driver work; it is not isolated GPU execution time.
Bounded records may omit earlier completions or late resource owners.
The current program during an upload does not prove the uploaded resource owner.
A readiness deadline failure is not proof of an infinite stall.
High failed at its original readiness assertion before active chassis and photo-view acceptance. A later preparation stage is progress, not a passed High gate.
Artifact ZIPs stay in the independent scratch collection; compact evidence retains verified receipts, original report details and all requested native diagnostics.
